scope_rule: Incremental only. Preserve previously approved Trailaris product, broker, customer-dashboard, trade-dossier, commercial-operator and central alerting architecture. Do not duplicate or reinterpret existing locks.
existing_architecture_preserved: Customer application and MT5 dashboard surfaces
Complete trade dossiers and trade drill-down
Central operations, telemetry and live-alert visibility
Sealed plug-and-play Market Execution Engine with no user strategy/model settings

verified_result_sharing.requirement: Users must be able to push/share their Trailaris results directly from either customer surface without manually reconstructing performance outside Trailaris.
verified_result_sharing.integrity_rule: Shareable results must be generated from canonical Trailaris execution/performance records so displayed results cannot be manually edited into a different performance claim.
verified_result_sharing.presentation_rule: Shared output may use a Trailaris-branded result card and/or verifiable result link while preserving appropriate account privacy and excluding sensitive broker/account credentials.

license_control_plane.owner_surface: Trailaris Admin Dashboard / internal control panel
license_control_plane.purchase_event: A completed valid license purchase must create a unique Trailaris license record and unique license number.
license_control_plane.license_number_rule: Each issued license number must be unique, immutable as the license identity, and traceable to its purchaser/customer record and commercial transaction.
minimum_admin_management: Renewal or expiry state where applicable
Audit history of administrative license actions
license_control_plane.engine_boundary: License administration controls entitlement and activation only. It must not expose or modify Trailaris strategy, model, risk, entry, exit or execution-engine settings.
license_control_plane.control_rule: The Admin Dashboard is the authoritative internal license-management surface. Customer-facing applications may display their own license identity/status but may not administer or alter license entitlements.

integration_rule: License state, customer application access, MT5 activation and central operations records must resolve to the same canonical customer/license identity rather than maintaining independent local license identities.
future_changes: Any extension beyond this hard lock must be explicitly approved and versioned; no silent expansion of customer-configurable Market Execution Engine controls is permitted.
